about: Tegretol (carbamazepine) is supplied nine times from November 2025 and one supply of Klacid (clarithromycin) is made on 24 February 2026 while the carbamazepine continues, by brand name only.
Carbamazepine (Teril) is supplied monthly through a 15-month history and one supply of erythromycin (E-Mycin) is made on 10 February 2026, in the middle.
Carbamazepine is supplied monthly with one short course of azithromycin (Zithromax), which is not clarithromycin or erythromycin, so it must not flag.
